title: The documented-workflow test requires the Quick Start fill-in step before the first strict check
description: The documented-workflow test requires the Quick Start fill-in step before the first strict check
no_spec_change_rationale: A test-only fix: the documented-workflow test checked the landing-page fill-in step only against add-spec, so a page that told readers to run check --strict on the untouched scaffold would still pass (DOCS-1). No spec or requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: The documented-workflow test fails when the landing-page Quick Start's fill-in line comes after the first specsync check --strict, and passes for the page as written (red then green)
